examples.hanzi: 火箭明天早上八点发射。
examples.pinyin: Huǒjiàn míngtiān zǎoshang bā diǎn fāshè.
examples.english: The rocket will launch at eight tomorrow morning.

examples.hanzi: 这种装置可以发射信号。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhuāngzhì kěyǐ fāshè xìnhào.
examples.english: This kind of device can transmit signals.

examples.hanzi: 请在一个小时之内回复我。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài yí ge xiǎoshí zhīnèi huífù wǒ.
examples.english: Please reply to me within an hour.

examples.hanzi: 房间之内很安静，什么声音都没有。
examples.pinyin: Fángjiān zhīnèi hěn ānjìng, shénme shēngyīn dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: It was very quiet inside the room, with no sound at all.

examples.hanzi: 你明天几点考试？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān jǐ diǎn kǎoshì?
examples.english: What time is your exam tomorrow?

examples.hanzi: 我昨晚复习到很晚，今天要考试。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuówǎn fùxí dào hěn wǎn, jīntiān yào kǎoshì.
examples.english: I studied late last night because I have an exam today.

examples.hanzi: 动物需要食物和水才能生存。
examples.pinyin: Dòngwù xūyào shíwù hé shuǐ cái néng shēngcún.
examples.english: Animals need food and water to survive.

examples.hanzi: 这家小公司在市场上很难生存。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo gōngsī zài shìchǎng shang hěn nán shēngcún.
examples.english: It is hard for this small company to survive in the market.

examples.hanzi: 犯人被关进了监狱。
examples.pinyin: Fànrén bèi guān jìn le jiānyù.
examples.english: The prisoner was locked up in jail.

examples.hanzi: 那个犯人终于承认了自己的错误。
examples.pinyin: Nàge fànrén zhōngyú chéngrèn le zìjǐ de cuòwù.
examples.english: The criminal finally admitted his mistake.

examples.hanzi: 他是个名人，走到哪里都有人认识他。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge míngrén, zǒu dào nǎlǐ dōu yǒu rén rènshi tā.
examples.english: He is a celebrity, and people recognize him wherever he goes.

examples.hanzi: 很多名人都来参加这次慈善活动。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō míngrén dōu lái cānjiā zhè cì císhàn huódòng.
examples.english: Many celebrities came to this charity event.

examples.hanzi: 海军的军舰停在港口里。
examples.pinyin: Hǎijūn de jūnjiàn tíng zài gǎngkǒu lǐ.
examples.english: The navy's warships are docked in the harbor.

examples.hanzi: 他从小就想加入海军。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù xiǎng jiārù hǎijūn.
examples.english: He has wanted to join the navy since he was little.

examples.hanzi: 今天是我第五次来这里。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ dìwǔ cì lái zhèlǐ.
examples.english: Today is my fifth time coming here.

examples.hanzi: 我住在这栋楼的第五层。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù zài zhè dòng lóu de dìwǔ céng.
examples.english: I live on the fifth floor of this building.

examples.hanzi: 假如明天下雨，我们就不去公园了。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú míngtiān xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù bú qù gōngyuán le.
examples.english: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go to the park.

examples.hanzi: 假如你是我，你会怎么做？
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú nǐ shì wǒ, nǐ huì zěnme zuò?
examples.english: If you were me, what would you do?

examples.hanzi: 这个故事的结局很圆满。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gùshi de jiéjú hěn yuánmǎn.
examples.english: This story has a happy ending.

examples.hanzi: 没有人猜到比赛的结局。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén cāi dào bǐsài de jiéjú.
examples.english: Nobody guessed how the game would end.

examples.hanzi: 在这里非法捕鱼是不允许的。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhèlǐ fēifǎ bǔ yú shì bù yǔnxǔ de.
examples.english: Illegal fishing is not allowed here.

examples.hanzi: 他因为非法入境被拘留了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi fēifǎ rùjìng bèi jūliú le.
examples.english: He was detained for entering the country illegally.

examples.hanzi: 这份合同有三页。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétong yǒu sān yè.
examples.english: This contract has three pages.

examples.hanzi: 签合同之前，请先仔细看一遍。
examples.pinyin: Qiān hétong zhīqián, qǐng xiān zǐxì kàn yí biàn.
examples.english: Please read it carefully before signing the contract.

examples.hanzi: 市场上的竞争越来越大。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng shang de jìngzhēng yuè lái yuè dà.
examples.english: Competition in the market is getting greater and greater.

examples.hanzi: 他们为了第一名而竞争。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen wèile dì yī míng ér jìngzhēng.
examples.english: They are competing for first place.

examples.hanzi: 这个小家伙真可爱！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎojiāhuo zhēn kě'ài!
examples.english: This little one is so cute!

examples.hanzi: 你这个小家伙，又偷吃糖了吧？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhège xiǎojiāhuo, yòu tōu chī táng le ba?
examples.english: You little rascal, you've been sneaking candy again, haven't you?

examples.hanzi: 别担心，没事儿，我自己能行。
examples.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, méi shìr, wǒ zìjǐ néng xíng.
examples.english: Don't worry, it's nothing, I can manage on my own.

examples.hanzi: 你今天没事儿吧？一起去逛街怎么样？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān méi shìr ba? Yìqǐ qù guàng jiē zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: Are you free today? How about going shopping together?

examples.hanzi: 他一直在争取这个难得的机会。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí zài zhēngqǔ zhège nándé de jīhuì.
examples.english: He has been striving for this rare opportunity.

examples.hanzi: 我们应该争取在周五之前完成。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi zhēngqǔ zài zhōuwǔ zhīqián wánchéng.
examples.english: We should try to finish before Friday.

examples.hanzi: 你先吃饭，接下来我们去看电影。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān chī fàn, jiēxiàlái wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: Eat first, and then we'll go see a movie.

examples.hanzi: 接下来的几天都是晴天。
examples.pinyin: Jiēxiàlái de jǐ tiān dōu shì qíngtiān.
examples.english: The next few days will all be sunny.

examples.hanzi: 人人都应该遵守交通规则。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu yīnggāi zūnshǒu jiāotōng guīzé.
examples.english: Everyone should follow the traffic rules.

examples.hanzi: 这里的饭菜人人爱吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de fàncài rénrén ài chī.
examples.english: Everybody loves the food here.

examples.hanzi: 这场车祸让他住了一个月的院。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng chēhuò ràng tā zhù le yí ge yuè de yuàn.
examples.english: The car accident kept him in the hospital for a month.

examples.hanzi: 开车要小心，免得发生车祸。
examples.pinyin: Kāi chē yào xiǎoxīn, miǎnde fāshēng chēhuò.
examples.english: Drive carefully so you don't get into a crash.

examples.hanzi: 当地人告诉我们哪家店最好吃。
examples.pinyin: Dāngdì rén gàosu wǒmen nǎ jiā diàn zuì hào chī.
examples.english: The locals told us which shop has the best food.

examples.hanzi: 你知道当地的天气怎么样吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào dāngdì de tiānqì zěnmeyàng ma?
examples.english: Do you know what the local weather is like?

examples.hanzi: 这家店可以用信用卡吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn kěyǐ yòng xìnyòngkǎ ma?
examples.english: Can I use a credit card at this shop?

examples.hanzi: 我的信用卡丢了，得马上挂失。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xìnyòngkǎ diū le, děi mǎshàng guàshī.
examples.english: I lost my credit card and need to report it right away.

examples.hanzi: 早晨的空气特别新鲜。
examples.pinyin: Zǎochen de kōngqì tèbié xīnxiān.
examples.english: The air is especially fresh in the early morning.

examples.hanzi: 明天早晨六点，我们在门口见面。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān zǎochen liù diǎn, wǒmen zài ménkǒu jiànmiàn.
examples.english: Tomorrow morning at six, let's meet at the door.

examples.hanzi: 把滚开的水倒进杯子里。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ gǔnkāi de shuǐ dào jìn bēizi lǐ.
examples.english: Pour the boiling water into the cup.

examples.hanzi: 小心，锅里的汤滚开了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoxīn, guō lǐ de tāng gǔnkāi le.
examples.english: Careful, the soup in the pot is boiling.

examples.hanzi: 她总是带着微笑跟客人打招呼。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì dài zhe wēixiào gēn kèrén dǎ zhāohu.
examples.english: She always greets guests with a smile.

examples.hanzi: 看到孩子们，老师微笑着点了点头。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào háizimen, lǎoshī wēixiào zhe diǎn le diǎn tóu.
examples.english: Seeing the children, the teacher nodded with a smile.

examples.hanzi: 人家已经等了你半个小时了。
examples.pinyin: Rénjia yǐjīng děng le nǐ bàn ge xiǎoshí le.
examples.english: I've already been waiting for you for half an hour.

examples.hanzi: 这是人家送给我的礼物，不能随便送人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì rénjia sòng gěi wǒ de lǐwù, bù néng suíbiàn sòng rén.
examples.english: This is a gift someone gave me, so I can't just give it away.

examples.hanzi: 这栋楼没有电梯，我每天爬六层楼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng lóu méiyǒu diàntī, wǒ měi tiān pá liù céng lóu.
examples.english: This building has no elevator, so I climb six floors every day.

examples.hanzi: 我们在电梯里碰到了邻居。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài diàntī lǐ pèngdào le línjū.
examples.english: We ran into a neighbor in the elevator.

examples.hanzi: 我这辈子最难忘的就是那次旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhè bèizi zuì nánwàng de jiùshì nà cì lǚxíng.
examples.english: The most unforgettable thing in my life is that trip.

examples.hanzi: 你这辈子有什么梦想？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhè bèizi yǒu shénme mèngxiǎng?
examples.english: What dreams do you have in your life?

examples.hanzi: 请问出口在哪儿？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn chūkǒu zài nǎr?
examples.english: Excuse me, where is the exit?

examples.hanzi: 地铁站有四个出口。
examples.pinyin: Dìtiězhàn yǒu sì ge chūkǒu.
examples.english: The subway station has four exits.

examples.hanzi: 书店在你的左边。
examples.pinyin: Shūdiàn zài nǐ de zuǒbian.
examples.english: The bookstore is on your left.

examples.hanzi: 他习惯用左边的手写字。
examples.pinyin: Tā xíguàn yòng zuǒbian de shǒu xiě zì.
examples.english: He is used to writing with his left hand.

examples.hanzi: 你做这件事的动机是什么？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuò zhè jiàn shì de dòngjī shì shénme?
examples.english: What is your motive for doing this?

examples.hanzi: 学习动机很重要，要不然很难坚持。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí dòngjī hěn zhòngyào, yàobùrán hěn nán jiānchí.
examples.english: Motivation to study is important; otherwise it's hard to keep going.

examples.hanzi: 这个礼拜五我们去看电影吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǐbài wǔ wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng ba.
examples.english: Let's go see a movie this Friday.

examples.hanzi: 上个礼拜我感冒了，一直在家休息。
examples.pinyin: Shàng ge lǐbài wǒ gǎnmào le, yìzhí zài jiā xiūxi.
examples.english: I had a cold last week and rested at home the whole time.

examples.hanzi: 我最喜欢黑色的鞋子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan hēisè de xiézi.
examples.english: I like black shoes the best.

examples.hanzi: 夜晚的天空是黑色的。
examples.pinyin: Yèwǎn de tiānkōng shì hēisè de.
examples.english: The night sky is black.

examples.hanzi: 这家餐厅名叫“老北京”。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng míngjiào "Lǎo Běijīng".
examples.english: This restaurant is called "Old Beijing."

examples.hanzi: 我有一只小猫，名叫豆豆。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yì zhī xiǎo māo, míngjiào Dòudou.
examples.english: I have a kitten named Doudou.

examples.hanzi: 你为什么要欺骗我？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme yào qīpiàn wǒ?
examples.english: Why do you want to deceive me?

examples.hanzi: 不要被广告上的话欺骗了。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào bèi guǎnggào shang de huà qīpiàn le.
examples.english: Don't be deceived by what the ads say.

examples.hanzi: 公司门口安装了监控设备。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī ménkǒu ānzhuāng le jiānkòng shèbèi.
examples.english: Monitoring equipment was installed at the company entrance.

examples.hanzi: 医生正在监控病人的心跳。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng zhèngzài jiānkòng bìngrén de xīntiào.
examples.english: The doctor is monitoring the patient's heartbeat.

examples.hanzi: 他向大家发出了邀请。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng dàjiā fāchū le yāoqǐng.
examples.english: He sent out an invitation to everyone.

examples.hanzi: 天花板上发出了一阵响声。
examples.pinyin: Tiānhuābǎn shang fāchū le yí zhèn xiǎngshēng.
examples.english: A burst of noise came from the ceiling.

examples.hanzi: 请帮我们拍照，好吗？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒmen pāizhào, hǎo ma?
examples.english: Could you take a picture of us, please?

examples.hanzi: 这里不能拍照，请把手机收起来。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ bù néng pāizhào, qǐng bǎ shǒujī shōu qǐlái.
examples.english: You can't take photos here, so please put your phone away.

examples.hanzi: 船上的人都穿着救生衣。
examples.pinyin: Chuán shang de rén dōu chuān zhe jiùshēngyī.
examples.english: Everyone on the ship was wearing a life jacket.

examples.hanzi: 我们在船上吃了晚饭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài chuán shang chī le wǎnfàn.
examples.english: We had dinner on the boat.

examples.hanzi: 火车穿过一片大森林。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē chuānguò yí piàn dà sēnlín.
examples.english: The train passed through a large forest.

examples.hanzi: 过马路时，要快点穿过去。
examples.pinyin: Guò mǎlù shí, yào kuài diǎn chuān guòqù.
examples.english: When crossing the road, cross quickly.

examples.hanzi: 这并非他的本意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bìngfēi tā de běnyì.
examples.english: This was not what he really meant.

examples.hanzi: 成功并非偶然，而是努力的结果。
examples.pinyin: Chénggōng bìngfēi ǒurán, ér shì nǔlì de jiéguǒ.
examples.english: Success is not by chance but the result of hard work.

examples.hanzi: 彼得每天骑自行车上班。
examples.pinyin: Bǐdé měi tiān qí zìxíngchē shàngbān.
examples.english: Peter rides a bicycle to work every day.

examples.hanzi: 我昨天给彼得打了个电话。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān gěi Bǐdé dǎ le ge diànhuà.
examples.english: I called Peter yesterday.

examples.hanzi: 成年人之间做爱应该建立在互相尊重的基础上。
examples.pinyin: Chéngniánrén zhījiān zuò'ài yīnggāi jiànlì zài hùxiāng zūnzhòng de jīchǔ shang.
examples.english: Sex between adults should be based on mutual respect.

examples.hanzi: 这部电影里有做爱的镜头，不适合孩子看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng lǐ yǒu zuò'ài de jìngtóu, bú shìhé háizi kàn.
examples.english: This movie has a sex scene, so it isn't suitable for children.

examples.hanzi: 我们是高中同学，认识十年了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shì gāozhōng tóngxué, rènshi shí nián le.
examples.english: We are high school classmates and have known each other for ten years.

examples.hanzi: 同学们，请打开书，翻到第五页。
examples.pinyin: Tóngxuémen, qǐng dǎkāi shū, fān dào dìwǔ yè.
examples.english: Students, please open your books and turn to page five.

examples.hanzi: 非洲有很多美丽的草原和野生动物。
examples.pinyin: Fēizhōu yǒu hěn duō měilì de cǎoyuán hé yěshēng dòngwù.
examples.english: Africa has many beautiful grasslands and wild animals.

examples.hanzi: 非洲的夏天比我们这里热得多。
examples.pinyin: Fēizhōu de xiàtiān bǐ wǒmen zhèlǐ rè de duō.
examples.english: Summers in Africa are much hotter than here.

examples.hanzi: 火警警报突然响了，大家马上离开了大楼。
examples.pinyin: Huǒjǐng jǐngbào tūrán xiǎng le, dàjiā mǎshàng líkāi le dàlóu.
examples.english: The fire alarm suddenly went off and everyone left the building right away.

examples.hanzi: 手机收到了暴雨警报。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī shōudào le bàoyǔ jǐngbào.
examples.english: My phone received a heavy rain alert.

examples.hanzi: 他今天状态不好，第一轮就出局了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān zhuàngtài bù hǎo, dì-yī lún jiù chūjú le.
examples.english: He was off today and got knocked out in the first round.

examples.hanzi: 这个球员因为犯规被罚出局。
examples.pinyin: Zhège qiúyuán yīnwèi fànguī bèi fá chūjú.
examples.english: This player was sent off for a foul.

examples.hanzi: 这个会议只限公司内部人员参加。
examples.pinyin: Zhège huìyì zhǐ xiàn gōngsī nèibù rényuán cānjiā.
examples.english: Only internal company staff may attend this meeting.

examples.hanzi: 手机的内部结构很复杂。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī de nèibù jiégòu hěn fùzá.
examples.english: The internal structure of a phone is very complicated.

examples.hanzi: 警察成功救出了人质。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá chénggōng jiù chū le rénzhì.
examples.english: The police successfully rescued the hostages.

examples.hanzi: 那些人质被关了两天才获救。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē rénzhì bèi guān le liǎng tiān cái huòjiù.
examples.english: The hostages were held for two days before being rescued.

examples.hanzi: 我想休息一会，再继续工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiūxi yíhuì, zài jìxù gōngzuò.
examples.english: I want to rest a while before continuing to work.

examples.hanzi: 你先坐一会，饭马上就好。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān zuò yíhuì, fàn mǎshàng jiù hǎo.
examples.english: Sit for a bit; the meal will be ready soon.

examples.hanzi: 他在话剧里扮演一个年轻的医生。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài huàjù lǐ bànyǎn yí ge niánqīng de yīshēng.
examples.english: He plays a young doctor in the stage play.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们喜欢扮演自己崇拜的英雄。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen xǐhuan bànyǎn zìjǐ chóngbài de yīngxióng.
examples.english: Children like to play the heroes they admire.
